subject: Business Models
title: Marketplace GMV vs Revenue
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Marketplace GMV vs Revenue.

hook.text: Airbnb's GMV is $73 billion. Its revenue is $8 billion. The gap is the money that flows through to hosts.

buildup.text: Gross Merchandise Value is the total value of transactions. Revenue is only the platform's commission.

discovery.text: High GMV but low take rate means the marketplace handles enormous volume but keeps little per transaction.

twist.text: Some companies inflate GMV to look bigger. WeWork counted total lease values as 'GMV' before its collapse.

climax.text: Investors now focus on take rate trends, not raw GMV. A growing take rate signals pricing power.

punchline.text: $73 billion flows through, $8 billion stays. The take rate is what matters.

quiz.question: What does a marketplace's take rate represent?
options: Percentage of GMV the platform keeps as revenue

details.summary: Gross merchandise value measures the total value of goods sold through a marketplace, while revenue is the portion the marketplace actually keeps as commissions, fees, and services..
details.whyItMatters: GMV is often used misleadingly to make marketplaces appear larger than they economically are. A marketplace with 10 billion in GMV but a 5 percent take rate has only 500 million in actual revenue..
takeaways: GMV measures total transaction value passing through the marketplace platform
Revenue is only the marketplace's cut, typically 5 to 30 percent of GMV
GMV growth without improving take rate or margins does not create sustainable value

faq.question: Why do marketplaces report GMV instead of just revenue?
faq.answer: GMV is always a bigger number that impresses investors and media. It shows the total economic activity the platform facilitates. It signals market position and potential..

faq.question: What is a healthy relationship between GMV and revenue growth?
faq.answer: Ideally revenue grows faster than GMV, indicating improving take rates and monetization. If GMV grows but revenue does not keep pace, the marketplace may be sacrificing margin for volume. Tracking GMV per active user alongside revenue per transaction reveals whether growth is healthy.
